headline: SK Hynix Shares Jump After-Hours on Record Q3 Results Driven by AI Demand
summary: SK Hynix posted record third-quarter 2026 earnings, sending its shares higher in after-hours trading supported by sustained demand for artificial intelligence memory products.
why: SK Hynix is a crucial global supplier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips used in AI computing accelerators.

impacts.name: SK Hynix Inc
impacts.why: Record quarterly results exceeded expectations, prompting an after-hours share price rally.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Strong earnings validate continued robust global enterprise spending on AI memory.

why_moved: SK Hynix shares jumped in after-hours trading directly due to the release of record Q3 2026 financial results driven by AI demand.
